decisions.statement: A subagent is held under the id of the tool call that ran the subagent.
Only a tool call named `Agent` starts a subagent.
A record saying every agent was killed stops every subagent at once.
A subagent awaiting a first answer is stopped by the next assistant record.
A subagent given no description is labelled by the kind the subagent was run as.
A tool result marked async leaves the subagent that result answers running.
A tool result with no result stops the subagent that result answers.
A resumed agent nothing here has is filed under the resumed id as its own row.
A stop by the user is read out of the refusal text rather than out of a field.
A task notification naming a task id stops the subagent that id names.
A record with a tool result yields no notification text.
Running subagents are ordered by label and then by the id of the tool call.
An agent id is learned from a launch receipt and from nowhere else.
A subagent that stopped keeps its row rather than leaving the records.
An ended subagent is a subagent whose launch and whose stop were both read.
A launch that was not read leaves no subagent to end.
A stop that was not read leaves its subagent running.
The absence of a running subagent is no end.
Ended subagents are ordered by the id each subagent acts under.

definition: the subagents a session's records show running
